title: 第三千三百七十八章 花千玥的心思第三千三百七十七章 花千玥的邀请
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
他看了一圈。
桌上摆着兽骨酒杯和吃了一半的烤肉，烤肉还没凉透。
这说明狼七刚离开不久。
他在兽骨王座的扶手上摸了一下，扶手上有狼七残留的体温和一股极淡的血腥味。
这时，殷洛璃发现了一个暗门，门没关，往下是一个向下的石阶。
石阶的尽头，是一个密室。
密室不大，只有矿坑大厅的一半面积，但很精致。
秦天看到密室深处还有一道小门。
他偷偷看了进去，看到一个光头大汉。
正是狼七。
他身上的血色长袍破了几道口子，露出里面的伤，像是刚经历一场恶战。
他咬着牙，无比的愤怒。
“星无极，这一爪，老子记住了。”
狼七的伤居然是星无极伤的，秦天有些意外。
他猜测，应该是星无极为了敲打着狼七，才打伤的他。
可是却看错了狼七的狼性。
这种人是很叛逆的。
密室的阴影里，秦天和殷洛璃对视一眼。
狼七又灌了一口酒，然后重重地把酒壶砸在桌上，壶底嵌进桌面半寸。
他低着头，双手撑着膝盖，像一头受了伤的野兽。

秦天思索后，没有现身。
而是拉着殷洛璃无声地退了出去。
出去后，殷洛璃好奇问道：“刚才为什么不现身？这个时候找他，应该更容易说服他。”
秦天摇了摇头：“我理解这种人，他不会服谁，我这个时候出现让他表态，他可能会连我也记恨上！”
“所以，最好是装不知道，他受了气，自然会偏向我们。”
殷洛璃微微点头，似乎有些明白了。
“那我们先去找花千玥。”
……
百花谷是整个天门洗礼圣地里最美的地方。
谷中很干净，到处都是美景，没有任何战斗痕迹。
美丽的花路，从谷口一直蔓延到山谷深处。
谷口守着两个女弟子。
content_en:
He looked around.
On the table were animal bone wine glasses and half-eaten barbecue, which had not yet cooled down.
This shows that Lang Qi just left not long ago.
He touched the armrest of the beast bone throne. There was the residual body temperature of Wolf Seven and a very faint smell of blood on the armrest.
At this time, Yin Luoli discovered a secret door. The door was not closed, and there was a stone staircase going down.
At the end of the stone steps is a secret room.
The secret room is not big, only half the area of ​​the mine hall, but it is very exquisite.
Qin Tian saw a small door deep in the secret room.
He peeked in and saw a bald man.
It was Wolf Seven.
The bloody robe on his body had several holes, revealing the wounds inside, as if he had just experienced a fierce battle.
He gritted his teeth, extremely angry.
"Xing Wuji, I will remember this claw."
Qin Tian was a little surprised that Lang Qi's injury was actually caused by Xing Wuji.
He guessed that it was Xing Wuji who beat Lang Qi so hard that he was injured.
But he misjudged the wolf nature of Lang Qi.
This kind of person is very rebellious.
In the shadow of the secret room, Qin Tian and Yin Luoli looked at each other.
Lang Qi took another sip of wine, then slammed the wine bottle on the table, with the bottom of the bottle embedded half an inch into the table.
He lowered his head and put his hands on his knees, like a wounded beast.
After thinking about it, Qin Tian didn't show up.
Instead, he pulled Yin Luoli and retreated silently.
After going out, Yin Luoli asked curiously: "Why didn't you show up just now? It should be easier to convince him if you find him at this time."
Qin Tian shook his head: "I understand this kind of person. He will not obey anyone. If I show up at this time and ask him to express his position, he may even bear a grudge against me!"
"So, it's best to pretend not to know. If he gets angry, he will naturally turn to us."
Yin Luoli nodded slightly, seeming to understand.
"Then let's go find Hua Qianyue first."
…
Baihua Valley is the most beautiful place in the entire Tianmen Baptism Holy Land.
The valley is very clean, with beautiful scenery everywhere and no traces of battle.
The beautiful flower road spreads from the mouth of the valley to the depths of the valley.
Taniguchi was guarding two female disciples.
